SELECT calendar_idx AS id, admin_idx AS adminIdx, title, event_date AS date, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, CASE WHEN all_day = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allDay, color, memo, event_type AS type, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT WHERE calendar_idx = #{id} AND admin_idx = #{adminIdx}
